window-1.title: Le Random
window-1.blurb: It's a whole independent archive of generative art — decades of people making images out of code — and I think you'll fall straight down the timeline and come out the other side with three new project ideas.

window-2.title: Supersystème: typography as image
window-2.blurb: A studio that treats letterforms like full-blown images rather than words — exactly the kind of expressive, world-building type play you'd end up hand-drawing at 2am for a project nobody asked for.

window-3.title: Lychee Mocktail With Rose
window-3.blurb: Tinned lychee syrup is pure Chinese-restaurant-childhood nostalgia, and here it goes full glamour — hot pink, rose petals floating on top, a drink that practically asks to be shot on flash with a cheongsam sleeve in frame.

window-4.title: The Lafayette Hotel's Vintage Lamps
window-4.blurb: You already know a room lives or dies by its lamps — this one's a love letter to the moody, thrifted, hotel-lobby glow you'd absolutely build a whole shoot around.

window-5.title: Soft Order, Bukit Merah
window-5.blurb: A barely-opened Bukit Merah cafe with Seoul-cool bones, an in-house bakery and drinks too pretty to drink — go now while it still feels like your discovery, and bring the film camera.
